intent.text: late afternoon golden light, warm, realistic

roads-main.name: Cobbled streets, pavements, lamps and plazas

roads-switchbacks.name: Switchback lanes, tram rails and escadinhas

player-car.name: Your car
player-car.description: Drivable car parked in the Praca do Comercio square.

then.text: Welcome to the Lisbon hillside. Walk up the market street, ride the yellow trams, or take the sports car in the square.

lisbon-ground.description: Lisbon hillside terrain: radial hill with crest plateau, roads and plazas carved flat, river channel along X, cobble/grass vertex colours. Entity must be placed at y=-5.

lisbon-houses.description: Rows of pastel Lisbon townhouses (azulejo facades, iron balconies, terracotta roofs) along one street of the Lisbon hillside; street index selects which street. Entity at y=-5.

lisbon-roads.description: Cobbled roads with limestone pavements, plaza paving, street lamps, tram rails and stone stairs for the Lisbon hillside. part 0 = ring roads/market/quay/plazas, part 1 = zigzag roads, tram rails, stairs. Entity at y=-5.

red-suspension-bridge.description: Red suspension bridge along Z (50 m long incl. ramps), deck at y=1.2 with ramps down to y=0 at both ends, two red lattice towers, catenary cables and hangers. Place entity at y=-1 (local ground is y=0, pin at -1).

lisbon-tram.description: Yellow Lisbon tram (remodelado) 9 m long along Z, 2.4 m wide: yellow body with cream band, dark windows, roof pantograph, bumpers, wheels.

laundry-line.description: Washing line strung across a lane along X with hanging coloured laundry (sheets, shirts, towels). Rope at local y=1.0, laundry hangs below to y=0.

castle-gate.description: A detailed medieval stone castle gatehouse with twin crenellated towers, a deep arched passage, iron portcullis, battlements, wall walk, arrow slits, and rear-facing architectural detail.

fountain.description: Tiered stone fountain with a round basin, pedestal, upper bowl and shimmering water.

hero-fountain.description: Three-tier sandstone fountain, 3.4 m wide x 3 m tall: octagonal basin R1.7 h0.82 with moulded rim and 8 carved panels; fluted column r0.22 to y1.3; scalloped bowl 1 r1.0 (y1.25-1.7); stem r0.14; bowl 2 r0.62 (y1.95-2.3); stem r0.08; pinecone finial to y3.0; blue emissive translucent water in each bowl plus thin falling sheets.

beach-umbrella.description: A detailed beach umbrella with a gently domed striped canopy, tilted wooden pole, radial underside ribs, sand mound, and a fringed beach towel in a coordinated palette.

stripeColor.description: alternating canopy and towel stripe color
